provider.description: OpenAlex is an open scholarly knowledge graph maintained by OurResearch. It integrates works, authors, sources, institutions, publishers, funders, concepts, topics, keywords, domains, fields, subfields, citations, open-access locations, identifiers, affiliations, funding, and metrics. OpenAlex provides a public REST API, bulk snapshots, documentation, premium access options, data-quality pipelines, and open-source tooling for discovery, analytics, research evaluation, and infrastructure.
institutional_context: Crossref, DataCite, ORCID, ROR, PubMed, repositories, and other scholarly metadata providers
Universities, libraries, funders, publishers, repositories, and research infrastructures
